comments: A lovely apartment right in the heart of everything. Jana was very helpful and easy to communicate with.

This apartment was a terrific home base for a wonderful week-long, extended family (2 grandparents, 4 parents, 6 adult grandchildren) stay in Prague. Only a half-block from Old Town Square, the location can't be beat, and we enjoyed views of the astronomical clock tower (with Prague Castle in the distance, across the river) from the large terrace. The kitchen is well-equipped, so we cooked a couple of meals at home (and did some grilling on the terrace) when not dining in Prague's excellent restaurants. The apartment occupies a full floor of the building, so it's very private and has 2 entrances to the central hallway, which helps with the flow of a large group across all the bedrooms. Thanks for a great stay!

We really enjoy he stay. The apartment was clean, new and on the top very modern, you feel right away as at home. Zdenek was responsive, provides suggestions and lots of information. We highly recommend the apartment.

Great place, it is listed for 15 guests, we had a group of 9 and we had a lot of space, so 15 people could easily fit in! The elevator is small, so when traveling with group you will need to make some extra moves. The place got equipped with everything we need for stay.

A truly kind, passionate and courteous familiy presented by Nami expected me with their wonderful appartement; modern, clean and functional. Finding anything to criticize was not really possible; sorry ..... 😅 👍!
Grate accommodation, responsible and helpful host, great location. The only issue is very loud entry door into the building which you constantly hear in first floor apartments
One of the best airbnbs I have stayed at! 100% recommend. Thuy is a great host and her apartment is located in an amazing walkable location.

Our stay at Michal's Airbnb in Prague was absolutely wonderful. The apartment was clean, well-decorated, and fully equipped with everything we needed for a comfortable stay—from kitchen essentials to cozy bedding. The atmosphere was peaceful, allowing us to relax after long days of exploring the city. The location couldn't have been better, situated in a charming neighborhood with easy access to public transportation, local cafes, and all the major sights. Michal was also an exceptional host, always quick to respond and eager to ensure we had everything we needed. We couldn't have asked for a better experience!

We booked the apartment last minute & so wasn’t expecting much however, the apartment exceeded our expectations and looked exactly as it does in the photos and was very very clean inside. Finding the apartment building was easy, check-in was easy & the staff even allowed us to store our bags as we arrived early. They were always friendly when exiting and entering the building and responded to messages very efficiently. The location was very good, a lot within walking distance or a short cab ride away. The area felt very safe & clean and would highly recommend to anyone thinking of booking this apartment. We were very happy with the overall experience ☺️

I liked that this apartment felt like a home and had personality. It was spacious with two rooms and a comfy leather sofa. The kitchen and bathroom were well equipped, Martin provides absolutely all the necessary items you need for a stay. Personally I prefer staying in a nice walkable neighborhood as opposed to the center, and the apartment is just a short 4 minute walk to the green line metro which will bring you to the center in minutes. Grocery store, shops, cafes, bars, restaurants all around. I would choose it again.

Lovely apartment. Very clean! Easy check-in and very responsive hosts. Unfortunately we were told the morning we were supposed to arrive that the apartment we were supposed to be staying in was undergoing renovations, however the hosts did arrange an alternative for us.
Loved the location, walkable distance to all sightseeing places, old town and parks, mountains and city centre! lovely terrace and very well thought out design :)
Second stay at Jirka's place and we really enjoyed it. Nice and spacious place with gated parking space and charging station.

The Airbnb was excellent and exactly what we wanted from our stay in Praha. the host was extremely responsive. Any issue we had, they responded in a timely manner and were super helpful. The stay wasn't perfect but the responsiveness of the host made up for it!

fantastic place to stay in the centre of Prague, very close to local attractions. apartment is great with everything you need plus the parking space. great communication with the owner. absolutely reccomend it. next time if I go to Prague, I'll defenitely choose this place again. thank you

Vadim was incredibly kind with me when I arrived at his airbnb. He gaves me recommendations about restaurants, activities… The room was perfect and very clean. The best way to spend good nights at Prague without spending a lot of money. Just go to this airbnb without any doubts. Take care of you Vadim. See you maybe in Paris.
Enjoyed our stay, despite not spending a lot of time inside. We had what we needed and for a good value. Would recommend!
The location is perfect, a lot of cafes and cool bars around. Not to far into the center too. The apartment was very clean and everything was according to the pictures. Would reccomend.

Perfect location right next to the Old Town. Although on a busy street was very quiet and private. Very clean and well designed, spacious apartment. Jan was an excellent host, although we didn’t get to meet him he was always responsive and gave us the information we needed. Would highly recommend staying here for any couples or even on your own.

Daniela’s place was really lovely, we thoroughly enjoyed our stay. Daniela was a wonderful host and made us feel at home. The location is great right by the Prague Castle and the Strahov Library. Is it a 30 second walk to the tram stop which can take you into the city centre. I definitely recommend! :)
Great place! Super responsive host. Cool place to host a lot of people. Great location. Easy walk to an awesome gelato place and all the things we wanted to see!
Good location and apartment. We were here in January 2025 and heating within the apartment was great! Very cosy and home like. It has all the facilities you need for a short stay in Prague :)

Luci"s place is very nice. With the public transport very close to the heart of beautiful Prague, but also just enough out of the tourist center to have a quiet spot close to a nice park. The place has all I need for a short, and even long, stay. This beats being on a dull apartment somewhere on whatever floor. Totally recommended! PS I'll come back and book a longer stay soon.
Very pleasant stay. The apartment had all we needed and was close to both the city center and the metro station.

We've had almost an excellent stay at Daniel's. The apartment has everything you need and more, once you are inside it's very quiet even during weekend (considering you are 5 mins away from the main square and on a busy road). Daniel is an amazing host, very quick response and very accommodating. The only down part of the apartment is the bed, me and my partner slept very bed on it, we both found it too hard (this might be personal preference). Overall we really recommend it! Thank you Daniel!
I can highly recommend Vaclav as a perfect host. The apartment was great for our needs.
We had a great stay in Monica's apartment. It was very clean, Monica was very friendly and gave us a lot of information about the area. We will gladly come back.

This apartment is comfortable and spacious. Driving through the city to get to the apartment was easy and it was great to have secure parking in the basement of the building. It's very close to the metro and walkable to the old town and restaurants. I would stay here again.

Apartment was spacious, clean and included a parking space in the courtyard. The apartment had everything necessary for a short stay. The front desk was friendly and helpful. The location by the tram stop meant you could get to most anywhere in central Prague in 15 minutes or less. We enjoyed our stay!

The apartment is really close to Prague main station and lots of touristic places. We really liked this apartment! Restaurant Kantyna is walking distance as well, so we went there to eat twice while we were in Prague. Adam is really kind and always reachable. I appreciate him a lot! Thank you Adam!
Great place next to the main tram lines to get you in town within 20 minutes. Very spacious and felt immediately like home.

Great place to stay since it is very centrally located! The place itself is very nice and cozy. Jana is an amazing host making you feel welcome since you arrive and making sure that you have a good stay. Would definitely recommend staying here!
I had a great stay at Kristina's play. She was very helpfull. I had a little problem with internet and she solved it immediately. I would come back to her place next time I am in Prague.

We stayed for 3 days and had a wonderful experience. Our flight was delayed, so we arrived late at night, but German was super accommodating and met us with the keys. The apartment was clean, spacious, and the high ceilings made it feel even bigger. The cozy balcony was a bonus. The area is quiet, with several cafes and bistros just a few steps away, and it's also close to the Old Town, making it a perfect location for exploring. Overall, it was a great stay, and we would definitely recommend this place to anyone looking for a comfortable place in a great location at a reasonable price.
